Vitality Vault Affiliate Payment Terms

  • Commision Rate: Earn 10% on every sale made through your unique affiliate link.
  • Cookie Duration: We offer a 30-day tracking cookie, meaning you'll earn a commission if a cutomer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking your link.
  • Payment Schedule: Payouts are processed monthly, ensuring your receive your earnings on time.
  • Payment Methods: Choose from Paypal, bank transfer, or other secure options, making it easy to get paid.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: Affiliates must reach a minimum of £150 before a payout is issued.
  • No Hidden Fees: Your commission is 100% Yours - we dont deduct additional precessing fees.
  • Bonuses & Rewards: Affiliates have the opportunity to receive free gifts and exclusive perks based on performance.
  • Refund & Chargeback Policy: If sale is refunded or disputed, the corresponding commision will be deducted from future earnings.
  • Exclusion of Shipping & Taxes: Please note that Shipping cost and taxes are excluded when calculating affiliate earnings. Commissions are based on the sale price of the product before these additional charges/costs.
  • Affiliate Support: Our team is always here to assist you with any questions or concerns. We offer dedicated affiliate support to ensure you have the resources you need to succeed.
  • Affiliate Terms Agreement: By participating in our affiliate program , you agree to our affiliate terms and conditions, which outline expectations, policies, and guidlines.
  • Promotional Guidlines: Affiliates are encouragedto promote Vitality Vault  products through ethical means, adhering to our brand guidelines and maintaining a positive image. Any misuse of affiliate links or promotional tactics may result in the termination of the affiliate partnership. 

By Joining Vitality Vault's Affiliate Program, You get a transparent, rewarding, and profitable partnership. Sign up today and start earning!

Additional Information

  • No Exclusivity Required: Our affilite program is non-exclusive, meaning you can promote other brands alongside Vitality Vault. We encourage you to expand your network and maximize your earning potential.
  • Global Reach: We offer free worldwide shipping, allowing youo to promote Vitality Vault to a globe audience. No Matter where your followers are, they can benefit from our high-uality products.
  • Marketing Materials: As affiliate, you'll gain access to variety of promotional assets, including banners, product images, and text links to help you effectively market our products.
  • Performance Tracking: Our affiliates dashboard allows you to monitor your clicks, sales, commissions, and overall performance in real-time, giving you full transparency and control over your earnings.
  • Affiliate Program Changes: Vitality Vault reserves the right to make updates to the affiliate program, including commission rates or policies. You will be notified of any significant changes in advance.
  • Compliance & Legal Requirements: Affiliates are responsible for ensuring they comply with all applicable laws, including disclosure regulations for affiliate marketing, ensuring transparency with their audience.

We are committed to supporting our affiliates with tools, resources, and guidance to help you succeed. Join us today, and let's grow together!
